get_action_mapper_by_name: get an action mapper instance by name using get_action_mapper with a string key like 'ball' or 'ramp'
sample_valid_action: sample a valid action from an ActionMapper using the sample method with valid_only and rng parameters
convert_action_to_user_input: convert a continuous action array to a UserInput object using action_to_user_input on any ActionMapper subclass
scale_ball_parameters: scale ball position and radius parameters using BallScaler.scale to map normalized values to scene coordinates
scale_ramp_parameters: scale ramp geometry parameters using RampScaler.scale to map normalized values to scene coordinates with rotation
